description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer DECSTR checkpoint: safe Rust owns soft-reset cursor preservation, DECOM reset semantics and main/alternate cursor-state isolation.

entries.notes: SoftResetState reproduces Microsoft's DECSTR observable: the active cursor position is preserved, DECOM is reset, existing margins may be reapplied, and subsequent CUP addressing resolves from the screen origin rather than the margin origin.

The same owner keeps main and alternate cursor positions independently; DECSTR while the alternate is active does not mutate the saved main cursor, which is restored verbatim when returning to the main buffer.
